title: Pfizer VIAGRA 原廠仿單 · 第 5.7 節
section: 5.7 Combination with other PDE5 Inhibitors or Other Erectile Dysfunction Therapies
quote: Such combinations may further lower blood pressure. Therefore, the use of such combinations is not recommended.
scope: 原廠 sildenafil 仿單對其他 PDE5 抑制劑併用的警語；補充外部來源，非原 moda-agent 仿單或 MedHop 證據。
